subject: Support hiring at Brightlane HR
body:
Hi Sam,

Brightlane HR had 4 open roles, as of 2026-10-21, Crustdata. Teams growing support often start by taking repetitive tickets off the queue. SupportPilot automatically resolves up to 45% of inbound tickets for teams handling more than 5,000 tickets per month. Would a short call next week be useful?
